title: Jim's pottery epiphany and fixation on ancient sites

tellings.quote: all of a sudden this thing came into my head fully developed

plain: In 1976, Jim Weiner says, an idea about pottery came into his head "fully developed," all at once, and after it he became fixed on ancient sites. Weiner, a man who says he has been taken by aliens, tells Michels this as something that happened to him. He tells it as a sign that the experience may have put ideas into his mind.
